title: Impact Of British Administration
definition: The systematic transformation of Indian socio-economic, legal, and political structures by the East India Company (EIC) to facilitate colonial extraction, market integration, and administrative control.
importanceInUpsc: This topic forms the bedrock of Modern Indian History, frequently appearing in GS Paper I (History) and GS Paper II (Governance/Polity) to explain the genesis of modern Indian institutions.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Impact Of British Administration.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Evolution of EIC from trading body to sovereign power
